text: {"lessons":["A few monthly gains or losses don’t establish a reliable trend, so I shouldn’t react to short-term price moves as if I can predict them.","Before adding to a position, I should check how much of my account it would represent and keep enough cash for flexibility; I’ve recently bought more Stock D as well as Stock B and E.","Selling Stock C above my average cost was a gain, but profit alone isn’t a reason to sell; I should make each trade consistent with my ten-year apartment goal."]}
